note: Local Mythos coding knowledge cards — idioms and threat notes, not model weights.

languages.name: Python
languages.threat_notes: Avoid pickle from untrusted data; use parameterized SQL; never hardcode secrets.

languages.name: HTML
languages.threat_notes: Escape user content; no inline secrets; CSP-friendly structure.

languages.name: JavaScript
languages.idiom: Match module system; no new frameworks unless asked
languages.threat_notes: Sanitize DOM inserts; avoid eval; pin dependencies.

languages.name: CSS
languages.threat_notes: Avoid expression() / untrusted CSS injection.

languages.name: Java
languages.threat_notes: No deserialization of untrusted streams; parameterized queries.

languages.name: C
languages.idiom: C11/C17; clear ownership; no buffer overflows
languages.threat_notes: Bounds-check buffers; prefer safer string APIs; ASAN in tests when available.

languages.name: C++
languages.threat_notes: Prefer smart pointers; validate all external input lengths.

languages.name: COBOL
languages.threat_notes: Validate numeric fields; avoid ALTER; careful with file status.

languages.name: R
languages.idiom: Consistent tidyverse or base; reproducible scripts
languages.threat_notes: Do not eval untrusted strings; pin package versions for analyses.

languages.name: MATLAB
languages.idiom: Vectorize clearly; match toolboxes already used
languages.threat_notes: Avoid eval; validate loaded MAT files from untrusted sources.

languages.name: TypeScript
languages.threat_notes: Same as JS plus trust boundaries at type edges.

languages.name: Go
languages.threat_notes: Context cancel; no SQL string concat.

languages.name: Rust
languages.threat_notes: Prefer safe Rust; audit unsafe blocks.

languages.name: C#
languages.threat_notes: Parameterized SQL; validate uploads.

languages.name: Ruby
languages.threat_notes: Avoid YAML.load; use safe loaders.

languages.name: PHP
languages.threat_notes: Prepared statements; escape output.

languages.name: Swift
languages.threat_notes: Validate all external data.

languages.name: Kotlin
languages.threat_notes: Same JVM injection rules as Java.

languages.name: Shell
languages.threat_notes: No eval; never pass unsanitized input to the shell.

languages.name: SQL
languages.threat_notes: Always parameterize; least-privilege DB roles.

languages.name: Lua
languages.threat_notes: Sandbox untrusted scripts.

languages.name: Perl
languages.threat_notes: Taint mode for untrusted input when applicable.

languages.name: Scala
languages.threat_notes: Same JVM rules as Java.

languages.name: Dart
languages.idiom: Null safety; Flutter or pure Dart
languages.threat_notes: Validate platform channel input.

languages.name: Elixir
languages.threat_notes: Do not trust external BEAM terms blindly.

languages.name: Julia
languages.threat_notes: Avoid eval on untrusted code.
